welcome.title: Welcome, {{name}}
welcome.body: You have five years. The clock is paused while you look around. This short tour covers your first month: the budget, your departments, decisions and the world map.

approval.title: Approval is everything
approval.body: The gauge shows how the public rates you. Hover “Why?” to see what voters score and every modifier pushing it up or down. Fall too low for too long and Parliament impeaches you.

budget.title: Open the budget
budget.body: Money drives everything else. Taxes fill the treasury; ministries spend it.
budget.hint: Click Budget in the side menu (or press F4).

budgetExplain.title: Taxes and allocations
budgetExplain.body: Move the sliders and the forecast updates before you commit. Higher taxes raise revenue but cost approval and growth; underfunded ministries work badly. A new budget can be enacted at most once every 30 days.

departments.title: Run your departments
departments.body: Every ministry is a department you run yourself. Each has services rated from one to five stars.
departments.hint: Click Departments in the side menu (or press F5).

departmentsExplain.title: Stars, funding, efficiency
departmentsExplain.body: Upgrade a service to add a star: better services make every rupee go further. Stars need funding to last; a department starved of its budget for months loses them. Your ideology and strategy are set here too.

clock.title: Start the clock
clock.body: Time moves one day per second at 1×. The clock pauses by itself when something needs you.
clock.hint: Press Space, or click 1× in the top bar.

decisionWait.title: Your first briefing
decisionWait.body: Within a few days your advisers will bring you a decision. Watch the top bar: the date is moving.
decisionWait.hint: Let the clock run until the briefing arrives.

decisionMake.title: Make the call
decisionMake.body: Each choice lists exactly what it will do. If you let the deadline pass, the default choice is applied and crises cost you approval for looking indecisive.
decisionMake.hint: Click Review on the banner and choose.

world.title: The world stage
world.body: Other nations watch India. Trade contracts, pacts and embassies are made on the World and Diplomacy screens.
world.hint: Click World in the side menu (or press F8).

handbook.title: The Constitution
handbook.body: Every number in the game is explained in the handbook. Open it any time with the ? button or by pressing H.

done.title: The nation is yours
done.body: On 1 January {{year}} the voters decide: you need {{approval}}% approval to win a second term, and voter fatigue grows each year. Good luck, President.
